name: Magpie
tagline: Every open tab, on one mood board
pitch: A Chrome extension that files any page in two clicks and tags the products you've already looked at.
problem: Forty tabs stay open just in case, and every re-sort looks new.

stats.label: clicks to file a page, and close the tab
days each product is remembered, adjustable
stores tested for tags, Zara to Amazon

features.title: Two-click saving
features.text: A button in the corner of every page fans out your collections.
details: Alt+Shift+S opens it; each bubble's number is its key
Hold Shift to close the tab as it saves
Right-click a photo to make it the cover

screen.alt: Magpie's save menu fanned out from the corner of a page: numbered bubbles for Rings, Dresses, New apartment, Honeymoon and Recipes, with Dresses highlighted

features.title: What you've already seen
features.text: On a store's grid, products you've scrolled past get a tag on their photo.
details: So after a re-sort you can tell what's new
Seen 3× for each look an hour or more apart
Fade them instead, or switch it off per site

screen.alt: A store's grid of dresses and rings with tags on the photos: Seen, Saved, Opened, Seen 3×, and one new item with no tag

features.title: A board to decide on
features.text: Rate, tag, rank and compare your saves side by side.
details: Shortlist, maybe or pass with one key
Sticky-note tags like too short or good colour
Each save says whether it comes in your size

features.title: Details filled in
features.text: With an API key, Claude reads each page for the specs that matter.
details: Cut and carat for a ring, fabric for a dress
Photos kept even after a listing comes down

screens.alt: The Magpie board: collections down the left, and saved dresses, rings, a sofa and a recipe as cards with ratings, prices, sizes and note tags
screens.caption: Nine saves across five collections
